files.rationale: Kept PR A's switch to sqlalchemy_lifespan (trimmed imports, seed_database moved ahead of the app and lifespan creation, hand-written lifespan and session maker removed) and used PR B's expanded trailing-comma formatting for the model columns, the only part PR B changed.

Took PR A's optional-import block because it already does what PR B wanted (noqa F401 on the optional import, a lowercase flag so pyright sees no constant redefinition) and also exports sqlalchemy_lifespan; B's HAS_SQLALCHEMY variant would have dropped the new export.
PR B's version is PR A's modernized mixin plus pyright ignores, TypeEngine[Any]/type[Any] annotations and an exploded description call, so it covers both sides.

Used PR B's snake_case variable names, `is` type comparisons and formatting, and kept PR A's fixes (`import types` with the Union/types.UnionType origin check for the `X | None` annotations, and the lowercase `list` assertion that matches the mixin); A's file-level `ruff: noqa: N806,E721` was dropped because B's renames make it unnecessary.
